files.description: Read documents and browse archive folders. Files cannot be edited here.
files.previewUnavailable: This preview could not be opened
files.riskyBody: This file can run commands or contain macros. It will not run in WorkPortal. Download it only if you trust its source, and scan it before opening.
files.unsupportedBody: This format needs a compatible application. You can download the original file without changing it.
files.sheetLimit: Preview shows up to 1,000 rows, 100 columns and 30 sheets. Download the original for the full workbook.
files.contentPreview: Content preview · original layout may differ
files.noText: This page has no text layer. Use the page image to read it.
files.name: Name

error.load: The file could not be loaded. Check your connection and access to this page.
error.format: The file is damaged, encrypted, or uses a format this browser cannot display. Download it to open in a compatible application.
error.size: This file exceeds the preview limits. Download the original to open it. Archives are limited to 1,500 entries, 80 MB expanded and three nested levels; individual previews to 32 MB.
error.archive: This archive contains unsafe paths, embedded programs, links or an unsupported archive layout. It has not been extracted.
error.password: A password is required, or the entered password is incorrect.
error.timeout: Opening took too long and was stopped. Download the file to open it with a desktop application.
